heading: Abandonment, destruction, or donation of property
lead: The Administrator of General Services may authorize the abandonment or destruction of property, or the donation of property to a public body, if—

tree.text: the property has no commercial value; or
the estimated cost of continued care and handling exceeds the estimated proceeds from sale.
